profiles.reason: Professional and facility directories share the existing account/practitioner/organization owner; they do not create a new clinical truth store or an owner per specialty. Preserve qualifications, expertise, biography/publications, languages, international certification and network affiliations; verify source, issuing authority, scope, expiry and status. Retain center-specific dialysis, endoscopy, transfusion, infusion, isolation/ICU, laser, rehabilitation, surgery, diagnostic, maternity/delivery and working-hour/contact capabilities. A directory claim is not current staffing, treatment privilege or patient-data authorization. Fertility success rates require denominator/time/cohort provenance and must not be treated as a personal outcome estimate.

profiles.reason: Security architecture, per-request zero-trust enforcement and monitoring form one existing shared security owner. Identity supplies authenticated subject/session; Consent supplies policy/grant and legal-authority evidence; Security enforces action/resource/context and Audit records outcomes. Authentication alone never authorizes patient data. Legacy ABAC marked future cannot defer patient/purpose/recipient checks required by the current MVP. Preserve mobile/server/API/encryption/monitoring and future HSM/confidential/quantum-resistant intentions without claiming certification or implementation.
